messages:
jordan: Alert — APAC-south1 GPU egress paths to modelstore are returning 5xx, error rate +28% in last 2m. Autoscaler drains not kicking. tagging @sana @lee.
ops-bot: created incident INC-2025-APAC-EGRESS-01, severity: high. bridge: https://call.example/INC-2025-APAC-EGRESS-01
sana: I'm pulling kube events and agent logs now. seeing tcp resets from nodepool-egress-07 -> modelstore-front.
lee: sounds like a network path problem. we can traffic-shift new allocations to apac-south2 but that will increase egress cost and add ~40–80ms latency for affected customers.
miguel: any customers currently getting 5xx or are these internal modelstore retries? need list for CS.
emily: Support alert: 6 customers reporting increased 5xx on embeddings endpoints (mostly APAC). CCing account owners.
sana: confirmed customer-facing errors. rolling a temporary policy: tag new pods in apac-south1 with routing:avoid, start draining existing sessions with graceful-failover window 30s. doing a small canary 10% to apac-south2 first.
jordan: 👍 do canary then scale. Also draft status page blurb. keep ETA conservative.
lee: note: apac-south2 has limited spare GPU slots, if traffic spikes we'll need to burst to global pool and potentially use cross-region egress — that will hit egress billing.
miguel: I'll prep a short customer-facing note and high-priority support thread. propose status message:
```
We are investigating elevated error rates for API requests originating in the APAC-south1 region that are causing failed requests and increased latency. Engineers are actively rerouting new traffic to a nearby region and working to restore normal service. We will provide updates every 15 minutes. Impacted customers may see increased latency or transient 5xx errors.
```

sana: applied routing:avoid to apac-south1 pool and initiated 10% canary to apac-south2 at 2251082800. monitoring.
ops-bot: scaling event: +12 allocation requests redirected to apac-south2.
emily: published status: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2025-APAC-EGRESS-01 — adding note about potential billing impact for rerouted traffic per policy.
lee: canary looks stable for 3 minutes, error rates on canary region ~0.8% vs 28% in south1. proceeding to 50% shift.
miguel: notifying Sales about potential egress delta and suggesting temporary credit if customer impact continues >2h. @emily please coordinate.
emily: acknowledged. opening internal ops->sales thread.
sana: increasing shift to 100% at 2251083000; starting background investigation on egress node configuration and kernel TCP offload settings on affected nodes.
jordan: good — monitoring dashboards show request success rate trending up. still seeing intermittent packet drops on nodepool-egress-07; isolating node for deeper diagnostics.
lee: re: cost, quick calc: expected extra egress delta ~+$6k/day if traffic stays in apac-south2 for 24h. flagging finance for threshold.
miguel: support thread updated, customers notified with ETA: next update at 2251083567 (~10m).
ops-bot: note: nodepool-egress-07 removed from rotation at 2251083055.
sana: root cause preliminary: misconfigured MTU during a rolling upgrade earlier today, causing fragmentation on certain paths; working on remediating kernel config and re-provisioning clean node.
jordan: set postmortem owner: sana, include timeline, cost delta, and customer comms.
emily: published customer update: "We have rerouted traffic and are seeing recovery for affected requests. Engineers are working full time to replace the affected egress node and validate network paths. We expect normal service within 60 minutes."
miguel: customers acknowledged, a few asked for SLA credit next steps — flagged to CS leads.
sana: replacement node provisioned and validated at 2251083120, rejoined pool after MTU fix. monitoring for 10m.
lee: metrics look green. error rate back to baseline across APAC.
jordan: closing incident in 15m if stable. please drop any follow-ups. great work everyone. :tada:
emily: final status page update and post-incident note queued.
ops-bot: incident INC-2025-APAC-EGRESS-01 status -> resolved at 2251083167.
